comparison.objective: Place two setting blocks at marked quarter points and install a glass unit in a window frame so it stands on both blocks without touching the sill.
comparison.physical_skill: Precise block placement followed by constrained glass insertion, including tilted room-side insertion in later versions, alignment against a stop, controlled support and release.
comparison.success_condition: Glass stands released and still in the rebate on both correctly placed blocks, centred and upright, with any sill contact, severe tilt or loss causing zero. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: This tests support preparation and collision-free insertion of a fragile panel into a narrow frame, not coupled screw adjustment, locknut countertorque or post-lock actuation retention.
